run_check_copyright_header: run the script to check and add Meta copyright headers to all Python and shell files in the repo
run_copyright_header_addition: run the script to automatically prepend the Llama 2 Community License Agreement header to files missing it
run_copyright_pattern_check: run the script to scan .py and .sh files for existing Meta or Facebook copyright patterns
run_blacklist_copyright_check: run the script to check copyright headers while skipping files listed in the BLACKLIST variable
run_copyright_header_fix: run the script to fix missing copyright headers across the repository by adding the standard Llama 2 header
